Completed [index.html](./index.html), the only file in the working directory. It includes the deterministic replay, procedural 3D battlefield, combat and collapse effects, wordless HUD, synthesized audio, and playback controls.

Both reference hashes matched: `82a5353d` and `2e8858d7`. The simulator uses the coordinate-defined air-lane length of 2,800 centi-tiles, which reproduces both vectors.

The strategy concentrates cannon splash at bends and overlaps flak coverage. It averaged **43.18 waves** across ten evaluation seeds. Seed `42` held **44.68 waves**, falling at tick `1807`.

I tested the local file in Chromium, verified the playback controls, and confirmed pixel-identical frames after backward scrubbing. No requested subsystem was omitted. FPS and audible mix quality were not measured.
